theater: 湖北黃州城與赤壁江岸

battle.name: 黃州之戰
battle.theater: 湖北黃州城與赤壁江岸
battle.brief: 嘉熙元年（1237）十月，蒙古口溫不花與都元帥張柔自光州南下，圍攻黃州城，在赤壁江濱伏擊宋軍夜襲。鄂州諸軍都統制孟珙回援，以戰船衝擊蒙古船陣、奪回舟船二百，突陣收復東堤，夜分七路擾亂敵營。蒙古挖地道、焚燒團樓逼近城基，宋軍築月城掘深坑，自月城發砲投石封堵地道，黃州守至次年春天。

kit.name: 配重投石車
kit.history: 長臂配重把石頭甩過城牆。工程比攻城武器更早決定勝負。

countries: 交戰的兩方是蒙古帝國與南宋。蒙古方面由大汗窩闊台統籌，自1236年起在河南、荊襄、兩淮與江北同時用兵，兵分多路：一路由宗王口溫不花領中軍，同都元帥張柔所部合兵攻黃州；萬戶史天澤另領一軍攻復州，再轉攻安豐軍；太師塔思攻大蘇山。漢族降將所部與回回兵、河西兵等外來兵種編入各路，由主帥節制。宋方則以兩浙西路、荊湖北路的邊軍為骨架，黃州由守軍與郡兵固守，鄂州設諸軍都統制司，荊湖另置安撫司、招討司調度兵船糧餉，後方由兩浙與江西轉輸。鄂州諸軍都統制孟珙是江漢兵馬的實際統帥，節制水軍與步騎，順江可北援襄樊、下達鄂州，是黃州戰場上宋方真正的樞紐；宋廷以便宜行事授其自行處置軍資、興築水利的權力，荊襄與兩淮的守軍則由各路招討使分頭頂住。兩軍的實際接觸集中在黃州城與其西北的赤壁江濱，後方調度卻橫跨江北、荊襄與兩淮，戰役因此自成一場橫跨數百里的體系對體系較量。
countriesEn: The two belligerents were the Mongol Empire and the Southern Song. On the Mongol side the war was directed from the Great Khan Ögedei: from 1236 onward the Mongols fought in Henan, Jingxiang, the Huai region and north of the Yangtze at the same time, splitting their forces into several columns. One column was led by the prince Kouwen Buhua (口溫不花), who marched together with the commander-in-chief Zhang Rou against Huangzhou; the wanhu Shi Tianze took a separate force to Fuzhou and then turned toward Anfengjun, while the chancellor Tasi (塔思) struck at Dashu Shan. Han Chinese troops who had entered Mongol service, together with Huihui and Hexi contingents, were attached to these columns under the authority of each commander. On the Song side the field armies of the Two Zhejiang West and Jinghu North circuits formed the backbone. Huangzhou was held by a garrison supplemented by local militia, Ezhou hosted a military command office, and Jinghu had its own pacification and recruitment commissions to move troops, ships and grain, with the rear supplied from the Two Zhejiang and Jiangxi circuits. Meng Gong (孟珙), commander of all Ezhou armies, was the effective master of the troops on the middle Yangtze, controlling both the river fleet and the infantry and cavalry, able to march upriver toward Xiangyang or down to Ezhou; he was the true hinge of the Song defence at Huangzhou. The court gave him discretionary authority over military funds and over river works needed for the defence, while the garrisons of Jingxiang and the Huai region were held in place by their own recruitment commissioners. Actual contact between the two armies was concentrated at the city and on the riverbank at Chibi to its north-west, but the rear arrangements still stretched across the country north of the river, Jingxiang and the Huai region, so the campaign remained a clash of systems spread over several hundred li.
people: 蒙古方面的關鍵人物是宗王口溫不花，他自光州南下後與張柔合兵攻黃州；都元帥張柔是漢族降將，久在蒙古軍中統兵，黃州之戰的分兵與設伏都由他部署；百夫長鞏彥暉率二百甲兵埋伏在赤壁江濱，捕到宋軍渡至半途的破綻，一擊而制勝。萬戶史天澤與太師塔思各領一路，分別壓向復州、安豐軍與大蘇山，使黃州守軍不敢抽兵北上或西援，也令鄂州方向時刻要防側擊。宋方最關鍵的人是鄂州諸軍都統制孟珙，他聞變自鄂州回援黃州，先以水軍乘風衝擊蒙古船陣，再以壯士突陣奪回東堤，入夜又遣劉金等分兵七路擾亂蒙古大寨，並主持築月城、掘深坑、發砲投石，封死地道。黃州守將的姓名在現存記載中並未留下，記載只說守軍與孟珙所部內外配合，糧餉則由鄂州與江南一路接應。
peopleEn: On the Mongol side the central figure was the prince Kouwen Buhua (口溫不花), who moved south from Guangzhou and joined forces with Zhang Rou before attacking Huangzhou. Zhang Rou, the commander-in-chief, was a Han Chinese general who had entered Mongol service, and it was he who arranged the division of the army and the ambush that decided the first clash. The centenary commander Gong Yanhui (鞏彥暉) commanded two hundred armoured men hidden on the riverbank at Chibi and struck the Song force when it was half across, winning the engagement outright. The wanhu Shi Tianze and the chancellor Tasi (塔思) each led a column of their own toward Fuzhou, Anfengjun and Dashu Shan, pinning the defenders of Huangzhou so that they could not send men northward or westward to relieve the siege and keeping the Ezhou flank permanently worried. The decisive figure on the Song side was Meng Gong (孟珙), commander of all Ezhou armies. He returned to Huangzhou when he heard of the attack, first driving his war fleet into the Mongol flotilla with the wind in the sails, then sending picked infantry to charge and retake the eastern dike, and in the night dispatching Liu Jin (劉金) and others in seven columns to disorder the Mongol camp. He also directed the building of the moon wall, the digging of the deep pit and the firing of stones and cannon from the wall, sealing the tunnel. The name of the Song commander of Huangzhou itself has not been preserved; the record only states that the garrison and Meng Gong's troops fought together from within and without, and that grain and pay were forwarded from Ezhou and the Jiangnan route.
kits: 卡面這件兵器是配重投石車，即以長臂配重把石彈拋出的拋石機，是十三世紀攻城與守城中最具殺傷力的拋射機。它在此戰的確定位置在宋方守城：蒙古軍挖地道逼近城基，宋軍在城內築起月城，居高發砲投石，壓制地道口並封堵自地道湧出的突兵。同一族技術在《宋史·兵志》所載的砲具之中即是同類，回回砲便是其中之一，十三世紀初已為南宋邊軍所知；蒙古軍在荊襄與江北的攻城同樣倚重這類投石機，但本戰的記錄並未點明雙方投石機的數目，也沒有留下任何一件具體機具的形制。除此之外，蒙古方面的裝備是重騎與步兵混合的大軍、在大湖一帶取得並在江上使用的近千條船、攻城用的地道與火攻手段（焚燒城頭團樓），以及回回兵、河西兵等兵種；宋方則有可作舟師的戰船、披甲的精兵（甲兵）與壯士，以及月城、深坑、團樓組成的城防工程。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the counterweight trebuchet, the stone-throwing engine that flings its missile from a long arm driven by a falling counterweight, and it was the most destructive projectile machine of the thirteenth century for both assault and defence. Its place in this battle is fixed on the Song side: the Mongols drove a tunnel towards the foundations of the city wall, the Song built a moon wall inside the city and from its top fired cannon and threw stones, dominating the tunnel mouth and sealing the enemy troops who came up through the shaft. The same family of machine appears in the armory lists of the Song History, where the Huihui pao is listed as one of the stone-throwing engines and was already known to Southern Song frontier troops in the early thirteenth century; the Mongols relied on comparable throwers in their sieges in Jingxiang and north of the Yangtze as well, though the record of this battle does not state how many engines either side used, and it preserves no description of any single machine. Beyond that, the Mongol equipment was a mixed army of heavy cavalry and infantry, the close to one thousand boats they had taken at the Great Lake and used on the river, the tunnel and fire attack that consumed the Song towers, and contingents such as the Huihui and Hexi troops. On the Song side were the war fleet that served as a river squadron, armoured infantry and picked assault troops, and the works of defence built out of the moon wall, the deep pit and the wooden towers on the ramparts.
tactics: 蒙古的戰法是分路多點、切割宋防：先取光州、復州、安豐軍與大蘇山等節點，黃州只是主攻面，其餘各路負責牽制，使宋軍無法集中；大軍屯於黃州城西北、控大湖水道，以近千條船維持浮運並伺機渡江。張柔分軍為三，在赤壁江濱埋下二百甲兵，等宋軍夜半水陸齊進、渡至半途而擊，宋軍因此大敗。攻城階段，蒙古先以步騎奪取長江東堤作陣地，再晝夜不停地挖地道、焚燒城頭團樓，最後以重刑因犯作先鋒，強行由地道突入。宋方的反制是多層的：孟珙先以戰船乘風衝擊蒙古船陣、四面合擊奪船，再以精銳壯士突入敵陣收復東堤，入夜後分七路擾亂蒙古大寨，使敵軍驚亂而互相攻擊；城內築月城、掘深坑，坑口與地道之上配置發砲投石的機械，專候地道突兵，並以城頭團樓分層拒守。守城、野戰與水戰三線同時拉開，是這場攻防最吃緊之處。
tacticsEn: The Mongol method was to attack on several fronts at once and cut the Song defence apart. Nodes such as Guangzhou, Fuzhou, Anfengjun and Dashu Shan were taken first, Huangzhou being only the main point of assault, while the other columns held the line and kept the Song from concentrating. The main army encamped north-west of the city of Huangzhou, controlled the water of the Great Lake, kept its floating transport alive with close to a thousand boats and waited for a chance to cross the river. Zhang Rou split his force into three and hid two hundred armoured men on the riverbank at Chibi, letting the Song army come by night over both water and land and striking it when it was half across, which destroyed the Song attack. In the siege phase the Mongols first took the eastern dike of the Yangtze with infantry and cavalry and used it as a position, then dug tunnels day and night and burned the Song towers on the ramparts, and finally drove condemned prisoners ahead of them so that they could force their way up the tunnel. The Song counter was layered: Meng Gong first drove his war fleet into the Mongol flotilla with the wind behind the sails, closing on four sides and seizing the boats; then he sent picked infantry charging into the enemy to retake the eastern dike; in the night he sent seven columns to disorder the Mongol camp until the enemy troops panicked and struck at each other; and inside the city he built a moon wall and dug a deep pit, with cannon and stone-throwing engines set above the pit mouth and the tunnel mouth to wait for whatever came up the shaft, the wooden towers on the ramparts forming a second line of refusal. Defence, field action and river action all pulled at once, and that was where the battle was decided.
data: 可查證的數字不多，但有幾組能夠確認。時間上，蒙古軍於嘉熙元年（1237）十月抵達黃州城西北，地道突擊被挫於嘉熙二年（1238）春，圍城前後歷時數月。兵力方面，張柔所遣百夫長鞏彥暉僅領二百甲兵即伏於赤壁江濱，孟珙擾營也只分七路，可見雙方用兵以百人至數千人計，而不是傾國之眾一次投入；蒙古大軍由宗王、都元帥、萬戶、太師分領，各路兵力的總數沒有留下。舟船方面，蒙古在大湖一帶取得近千條船，宋軍水戰後由孟珙奪回舟船二百只。城防方面，宋軍築月城一座，掘深坑一道（史稱萬人坑，其名多為誇稱），並在月城上配置發砲投石的機械。地理上，黃州在長江北岸，光州在其北，復州在西，安豐軍在東南，蒙古三路同時作戰，戰線縱深數百里，鄂州則在黃州下游數百里水路之外，故援軍能夠及時趕到。雙方總兵力、攻城器械數目、坑的深寬、蒙古撤退方向與兩軍損耗，現存記載均無確數，不可臆造。
dataEn: Verifiable figures are few, but a few sets can be used. On timing: the Mongol army reached the north-west of Huangzhou in the tenth month of the Jiaxi era, October 1237, the tunnel assault was frustrated in the spring of the following year, 1238, and the siege ran for several months. On troops: the centenary commander Gong Yanhui was sent by Zhang Rou with only two hundred armoured men to lie in wait on the riverbank at Chibi, and Meng Gong's night harassment was divided into seven columns only, which shows that both sides committed men in hundreds and thousands rather than pouring in a national host in one stroke; the Mongol army was led in separate columns by a prince, a commander-in-chief, a wanhu and a chancellor, and the total of each column is not recorded. On boats: the Mongols took close to a thousand craft around the Great Lake, and after the river action Meng Gong recovered two hundred of them. On the defences: the Song built one moon wall, dug one deep pit (known in the sources as the pit of ten thousand, a plainly rhetorical name), and mounted cannon and stone-throwing engines on the moon wall. On geography: Huangzhou stood on the north bank of the Yangtze, with Guangzhou to its north, Fuzhou to the west and Anfengjun to the south-east; the Mongols fought on three fronts at once, so the line of operations ran to several hundred li in depth, while Ezhou lay several hundred li of river downstream, which is why the relief force arrived in time. The overall strength of either army, the number of siege engines, the depth and width of the pit, the direction of the Mongol withdrawal and the losses on both sides are simply not recorded, and no numbers should be invented for them.
cause: 黃州之戰是端平北伐崩潰之後蒙古全面南征的一環。1234年蒙古滅金，1235至1236年宋廷乘虛北伐、收復三京，卻在河南、關中連遭反擊而全線退回。此後窩闊台改以雪恨兼取財為目標，下令大軍分道攻宋，兩淮、荊襄、江北同時受兵，志在打開通向長江中游與江浙的通道。黃州扼長江北岸，處在漢水與大別山之間的水陸孔道上，是江防體系上把襄樊、鄂州與江州串成一線的樞紐；得之，蒙古才談得上順流東下，攻鄂州、攻江州、攻襄樊。1237年蒙古分路大舉、兵鋒迫近江淮，宋廷因此把黃州列為必守之地，寧可抽調鄂州主力回援，也不容城池落入敵手，因為一旦黃州有失，江北的船糧線與襄樊的外圍都會暴露在敵騎之下。宋廷並未把全部希望寄在黃州一城，蒙古分路的同時，宋方也以各路招討使分頭頂住淮上與川邊的壓力。
causeEn: The battle of Huangzhou was one piece of the full Mongol offensive that followed the collapse of the Duanping northern campaigns. The Mongols had destroyed Jin in 1234; between 1235 and 1236 the Song court, sensing the opportunity, marched north and recovered the three capitals, only to be driven back from Henan and Guanzhong by Mongol counterstrokes. Ögedei then set his sights on revenge and plunder at once and ordered the armies into Song territory by several routes, striking the Huai, Jingxiang and the country north of the Yangtze simultaneously, with the object of opening a road to the middle Yangtze and to Jiangzhe. Huangzhou commanded the north bank of the Yangtze at the land-and-water passage between the Han River and the Dabie Mountains, and it was the joint in the Song river defence system that strung Xiangyang, Ezhou and Jiangzhou into one line. Held, it would let the Mongols go downstream to attack Ezhou, Jiangzhou and Xiangyang. In 1237 the Mongol columns were pressing towards the Huai and the river, so the Song court classed Huangzhou as a city that must be held, and pulled the main Ezhou force back to relieve it rather than let the place fall, because a lost Huangzhou would have exposed the northern river supply line and the outworks around Xiangyang to Mongol horsemen. The court did not place all its hopes in a single city: while the Mongols split their columns, the Song answered with recruitment commissioners holding separate fronts in the Huai region and on the Sichuan edge.
impact: 黃州守住，卻把南宋江防的真相攤開：單靠城池守禦擋不住蒙古的多路進攻，必須有可以機動、可以反擊的水陸大軍。孟珙此役之後總領荊襄兵馬，沿襄江修堰蓄水、以水代兵，把襄樊周邊的攻守扭成消耗與反消耗，他經營的江漢防線成為南宋頂住蒙古第二輪大規模南侵的骨架之一。技術面亦有推進：地道的進攻逼出月城、深坑、砲石反制的成熟組合，兩軍在長江中游互相學習攻城與防城，此後荊襄、釣魚城一線的攻防都沿這條路徑演進。蒙古方面則被迫改道，1238年後轉向淮上攻安豐、壽春，黃州一役等於替江淮戰線爭取到部署襄樊與江州防務的時間，也讓宋廷看見配重投石車這類攻城器械在守城一端同樣致命，砲具的調配自此成為城防籌劃的一部分。
impactEn: Holding Huangzhou exposed the truth about the Song river defence: city walls alone could not stop a multi-column Mongol offensive, and what the south needed was a mobile force of soldiers and sailors able to counterattack. After this campaign Meng Gong took overall command in Jingxiang, raised weirs on the Xiang river to store water and use the flood against the enemy, and turned the fighting around Xiangyang into a grind of attrition; the line he organised on the middle Yangtze became one of the frameworks that carried the Southern Song through the Mongols' second great invasion. There was technical progress too. The tunnel attack forced out a mature combination of moon wall, deep pit and stone-throwing counterfire, and both armies on the middle Yangtze learned from each other about attacking and defending cities, a line that later runs through Jingxiang and Diaoyucheng. The Mongols were forced to change direction: after 1238 they turned to the Huai and to Anfeng and Shouchun, so the holding of Huangzhou bought the Jiang-Huai front the time it needed to garrison Xiangyang and Jiangzhou. It also showed the Song court that a counterweight trebuchet was as deadly on the defending side as on the attacking one, and the allocation of artillery and stone-throwers became part of the calculation of city defence from then on.
result: 結局是守城方得勝、攻擊方受挫。蒙古軍初戰得手，靠赤壁江濱的伏兵重創宋軍夜襲之師；孟珙回援後連出數着：乘風衝船奪回舟船二百、壯士突陣收復東堤、夜分七路擾營使敵軍自亂，蒙古兵在黃州城西北始終未能展開攻城。嘉熙二年春，蒙古以重刑因犯從地道強突，突兵盡落宋軍預掘的深坑，宋軍在月城上發砲投石，坑口與地道盡被封住，蒙古軍最終退走，黃州城未失。戰果的規模沒有確數可考，雙方損耗、蒙古撤退方向與所棄器械皆無記載；但守住黃州、牽制蒙古在長江中游的推進，是可以確定的下場。蒙古退走的方向、是否再圖東下，以及雙方折損的器械與糧秣，都沒有留下記載；能確定的只是黃州仍在宋廷手中，蒙古的水陸進攻第一次在長江中游被完整地擋了回去。此役之後，蒙古在江漢一線的攻勢轉緩，宋廷也得以把注意力移回襄樊。
resultEn: The outcome was a success for the defenders and a check for the attackers. The Mongols won the first exchange, catching the Song night attack with the ambush hidden on the riverbank at Chibi and wrecking it. Once Meng Gong arrived he struck repeatedly: he drove his ships into the Mongol flotilla with the wind behind them and took back two hundred boats, he sent picked infantry charging through the enemy line to retake the eastern dike, and in the night he sent seven columns into the Mongol camp until the enemy turned on itself, so that the besiegers at the north-west of the city never got their siege properly organised. In the spring of 1238 the Mongols drove condemned prisoners up the tunnel for a final push; every one of them fell into the deep pit dug in advance by the Song, the Song fired cannon and threw stones from the moon wall, the pit mouth and the tunnel were sealed, and the Mongol army eventually withdrew, leaving the city of Huangzhou in Song hands. There is no reliable figure for the scale of the result: the losses on both sides, the direction of the Mongol retreat and the engines they abandoned are all unrecorded. That Huangzhou was held, and that the Mongol advance on the middle Yangtze was checked, is however certain. After the campaign the Mongol pressure in the middle Yangtze eased, and the Song court was able to turn its attention back to Xiangyang. The direction of the Mongol withdrawal, whether they tried again to move east, and the engines and provisions lost on either side are all unrecorded; what can be settled is that Huangzhou remained in Song hands and that a Mongol advance along the river was, for the first time, completely halted on the middle Yangtze.
